scope.source_data_path: PE v3 snapshots + read-only NFS; PC v4 metadata normalized
scope.execution: production n2k Wizard foreground full, code updates and sealed resume on the same branch/PR

qualification_notes: Initial problems and code updates are distinguished from first-attempt success.
Rocky IDE first completion followed a service code update; Rocky SATA/SCSI first completion used the new NetworkManager preparer.
Windows 3 first runs reached Running but timed out before QGA; a native 64-bit firstboot code update through SYSTEM tasks completed the same immutable operation without offline managed-image access.

Windows IDE hibernated first attempt was blocked before import. The named source was operator-started once and a fresh r2 task used authenticated full shutdown. Product code does not auto-start failed sources.
Windows adapter covers basic GPT/NTFS DATA T:, online/RW, unchanged OfflineShared SAN policy. Original Windows static IP restoration is not part of this v1 adapter; DHCP addresses were observed.

Windows report boot_id is an opaque startup token. RTC/time-service correction after host start can shift later Win32 LastBootUpTime by nine hours; after-restart proof checks a changed token and the current committed binding/scope rather than treating it as an exact wall-clock timestamp.
Linux proof is 2 ROOT metadata fixtures and 36 DATA files per VM; Windows proof is 36 DATA files per VM plus ROOT/DATA fsync I/O and disk identity.
Falloc allocation evidence records import/first-start policy; it does not assert permanent physical extents after guest discard.
Formal Release/full offline RPM installation, new guest restoration for direct libvirt/RAW/RBD, and additional OS/network/controller combinations are outside this qualification.
